discharges: RYA-946 'Mandatory Solar reference-line-set census - AGSS21 lineage, all bands', for Al. Raised as RYA-1141 check D3 (FAIL).
wall_note: AGSS21 publishes no Al line list, but its cited primaries do. The rows were found one step further down the chain, so the RYA-946 wall does not apply.

published_line_count_conflict.authority: the PRIMARY. NL2017 Sect. 3.1.5 removes exactly one line from Scott's seven, and Fig. 8's axis names the remaining six individually: 6696 6698 7835 8912 10768 10872.
published_line_count_conflict.why_not_five: AGSS21's 'these five Al i lines' reproduces from neither source it cites. It is recorded, NOT resolved: see raw/lineage_quotations.md for the two candidate explanations, neither of which any of the three papers states.
published_line_count_conflict.consequence: A downstream reader must not inherit 'five'. A replication measuring this set measures SIX lines.

match.basis: DERIVED, then swept, then nulled. Printing is not the binding term: the two primaries disagree with each other by up to 0.008 A on the SAME transition (Nordlander & Lind 6696.015 vs Scott 6696.023) and canonical_gf follows Scott's scale, so the window must clear ~8 mA. Adopted at the smallest tolerance where the count has plateaued, nothing is ambiguous, and all 8 bodily displacements match NOTHING.
match.null_design: the same sweep with the reference wavelengths displaced bodily by [-11.0, -7.0, -5.0, -3.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0, 11.0] A. A window wide enough to match by coincidence matches the displaced set too.

⚠️ ep_separation_margin.note: The two closest lines in EP share an upper level and differ by 0.000 eV -- 20000000000x BELOW line_match.EP_TOL_EV. EP cannot separate them; only the 2.7 A wavelength gap and the LEVEL can. RYA-1151: an EP tolerance is not a level identity.

🔴 findings.finding: Al I 10768.363 A -- 4p 2Po(1/2) -> 5d 2D(3/2), one of the SIX lines carrying AGSS21's adopted A(Al) = 6.43 -- is ABSENT from canonical_gf under any species.
🔴 findings.why_it_is_not_an_ingest_gap: 32 rows of C/Fe/Si/Na/Ti/Cr/Mg/Ca lie between 10700 and 10850 A, and its own multiplet partner is held at 10782.045 A. The line is specifically missing.
🔴 findings.consequence: A replication of AGSS21's Al on our line list can measure at most 5 of the 6 lines. Codex cannot reproduce that solar value as published until the line is ingested.

🔴 findings.finding: Every log gf in the AGSS21-lineage Al set is Opacity Project / TOPbase LS-coupling THEORY (Mendoza et al. 1995), on all seven lines and in both primaries.
🔴 findings.consequence: Matching a Codex line into this set is evidence the lineage USED it and nothing about its gf quality. RYA-946: an AGSS21 abundance value is not a gf grade. Note this is the same defect RYA-1174 reports from the other direction inside RYA-1132's own manifest.

🔴 findings.finding: Al I 8912.900 A: Codex holds log gf = -2.348 (KURUCZ) against the source's -1.963 (TOPbase). A 0.385 dex disagreement on a line the AGSS21 lineage uses -- 3.5x the next largest delta in the set.

delta_loggf_distribution.note: Codex minus published. The published side is Opacity Project THEORY throughout, so this is a theory-vs-whatever-we-hold difference and NOT an error bar.

🔴 findings.consequence: Measuring this line on OUR gf rather than the published one moves its inferred abundance by about +0.385 dex -- it is weak (EW 3.0 mA, on the linear part of the curve of growth), so the shift is very nearly the gf difference. A 'replication of AGSS21' that silently used canonical gf would not be replicating AGSS21 on this line. RYA-946's fixed-asset rule says the line list is established from the reference study and shared unchanged; this is where the two scales part company.
🔴 findings.not_adjudicated_here: Which value is right is a gf question, not a census question. Recorded, not resolved (RYA-161).

🔴 findings.finding: The two lines Scott weights highest -- 6696.015, 6698.672 A, weights 2+3 of the 9 weight units spread over the SIX used lines -- are exactly the two Al I lines Codex holds at LAB tier, from Burheim et al. 2023.
🔴 findings.⚠️ weight_frame: 9 weight units over Nordlander & Lind's SIX used lines; 10 over Scott's SEVEN. The adopted value rests on the six, so the six are the frame.
🔴 findings.consequence: Where the source analysis is most confident, so are we.

does_not_unblock: This census discharges the RYA-946 gate ONLY. Al is not FROZEN_READY_FOR_MEASUREMENT: RYA-1151, RYA-1174, RYA-1176 and RYA-1177 remain open, and RYA-1173-F1 is new.
